title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 lead writer leaves Sandfall
subject: clairobscur
description:
What do you want from Sandfall's next game? 👇

Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, lead narrative designer on Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, told GamesBeat she left Sandfall Interactive in July 2026. The 2025 RPG won Game of the Year at The Game Awards, and her writing earned a BAFTA Breakthrough award.

Sources: GamesBeat interview via Video Games Chronicle (Nov 18, 2026)
Game footage © Sandfall Interactive / Kepler Interactive.

scenes.text: Clair Obscur's lead writer has left Sandfall Interactive.
Jennifer Svedberg-Yen told GamesBeat she left the studio in July, after finishing her work on Expedition 33.
She gave no reason beyond this: we've parted ways.
Her first game writing credit earned her a BAFTA Breakthrough award, and Expedition 33 won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025.
Now she wants to work on her own projects and mentor new writers.
Sandfall hasn't commented, and it still hasn't announced its next game.
